paragraphs: Acuity Brands sells lighting equipment, with a product menu grouped by fixture type that begins with downlights and cylinders. Outdoor categories include floodlighting and landscape lighting. There are also fixtures for confinement and vandal-resistant settings.

Lighting controls run alongside the fixtures, and some luminaires carry the controls embedded in them. Separate control hardware includes outdoor photocontrols and sensors. Wall stations and switches are listed as well. The company also sells components such as LED drivers and light engines. Life safety products include emergency lighting units and remotes.

For anyone specifying a job, the site offers lighting design resources. BIM files can be downloaded by brand. Compliance pages address California energy requirements. Another covers the Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act. The company publishes a product security vulnerability policy. The footer carries a copyright notice for Acuity Inc.
